summary: Tested iteration 5 features with MEGA and Telegram mocked, using throwaway TEST_ DBs. Changed the 5 old 'Save ho gaya' assertions to check bot.sb('SAVE HO GAYA'). Added tests/test_style_wallpaper_rename.py with 11 tests: sb mapping; CREDIT in HELP; HELP<=1024; START_KB callbacks accs/fo/wp; /start reply_photo; /wallpaper; wp, fo and accs callbacks (accs from a photo message uses reply_text, from text uses edit); accounts_view ends with CREDIT; non-owner refused for /start, /wallpaper and the wp/fo/accs callbacks; save reply header, contents, CREDIT and keyboard for files (r + i, 'Options') and folders (r + o, 'Kholo'); tapping r then sending text calls ms.rename(new_handle, text) and shows the parent folder view; no keyboard when the import returns no handle. 52/52 pass with xdist and with -n 0. ruff F clean. All 4 wallpaper URLs return 200 image/jpeg (~1MB). Frontend: hero header has the anime background, credit-footer shows 'Made by DD FREE DISH', bot status and 1 account row render, refresh works. The real DB is unchanged (only dac6ff85) and no TEST_ DBs are left.

issues: Horizontal overflow: scrollWidth 414 vs 390. The left-column panels (.space-y-6, .panel) stretch to 414px because the long '@Mega_handler_bot' handle (large font) does not wrap. Add min-w-0 on the grid children and break-all/overflow-wrap:anywhere on .handle, or use a smaller font on mobile.
The COMMANDS list on the dashboard does not include /wallpaper or /status (the bot HELP does). Footer 'MADE BY' text is small and muted, which is acceptable.

action_items: Fix 24px horizontal overflow on mobile (min-w-0 on grid children + wrap .handle)
Optional: add /wallpaper to the dashboard COMMANDS list
critical_code_review_comments: HELP is sent with parse_mode=Markdown (v1). It is safe right now, but any future '_' or '*' in HELP will break the /start caption. Keep it escaped.

Rename after save: on_text sends the user's text to MEGA unchanged, with no length check and no check for '/' (a name containing only spaces is already blocked by strip()). Consider simple validation.
Earlier minor items (CONFIRM_RE 'confirm/' variant, stale mega_signups cleanup) are still open.
